tasks.brief:
Implementation constraints: Create a new file src/static/rain.js. Must be a plain script (no module system), exposing window.MatrixRain = { start: fn, stop: fn }. No external libraries. Use requestAnimationFrame for animation loop. Throttle to ~20fps via timestamp check. Pause on document.hidden. Handle window resize. If prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, draw one static frame and do not animate.

Behavioral specification: start(): Create a full-viewport <canvas> as document.body's first child with data-testid="matrix-rain", position fixed, inset 0, z-index 0, pointer-events none, opacity 0.35. Run digital rain: columns ~14px wide, random glyphs from katakana (0x30A0-0x30FF) and digits (0-9). Head brighter than tail, fading via translucent black fillRect each frame. Colors: head 'rgb(190,255,200)', trail 'rgb(60,220,120)'. stop(): Cancel animation and hide canvas (display none) — do not destroy it.

Acceptance condition: window.MatrixRain.start() creates the canvas and starts animation; window.MatrixRain.stop() hides it. Canvas has correct attributes and styling. Animation respects reduced motion and visibility.

Implementation constraints: Edit src/static/style.css. Append a [data-theme="phosphor"] variable block. Do not touch anything outside the appended block. Use oklch color space for variables. Override border-radius to 0.25rem. Set font-family to ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace. Add .matrix-scanlines overlay on chat panel via repeating-linear-gradient ::before (2px period, low alpha, pointer-events none). Add text glow on assistant text and headers (text-shadow 0 0 6px currentColor at low alpha). Add .box-glow on terminal-ish containers (subtle green ring + outer glow). Ensure app chrome sits above rain canvas (app wrapper gets position relative / z-index 1 — do this in a theme-neutral way if not already true).

Behavioral specification: Map EXISTING theme variable names to phosphor spec tokens: background oklch(0.16 0.02 155); foreground/text oklch(0.9 0.16 150); primary/accent-strong oklch(0.82 0.24 148) with dark green contrast foreground; secondary accent oklch(0.75 0.19 165); cards/surfaces oklch(0.20 0.025 155); borders 18%-alpha primary, inputs 12%, focus ring 60% (color-mix or oklch alpha).

Acceptance condition: [data-theme="phosphor"] block exists with correct variables and styles. Scanlines overlay, text glow, and box glow are present. App chrome z-index is correct.

Implementation constraints: Edit src/static/index.html. Add <script src="/static/rain.js"></script> BEFORE the app.js script tag. Do not modify any other part of the file.

Behavioral specification: Ensure rain.js is loaded before app.js so that window.MatrixRain is available when app.js runs applyTheme().

Acceptance condition: rain.js script tag exists in index.html and appears before app.js script tag.

Implementation constraints: Edit src/static/app.js. In the THEMES array add 'phosphor' (after 'matrix'). Add its toggle icon mapping (a text glyph, e.g. '𐌘' or '>_' — any non-emoji marker consistent with THEME_ICONS' type). In applyTheme(), after setting the attribute: if theme === 'phosphor' call window.MatrixRain.start(), else window.MatrixRain.stop() (guard with typeof window.MatrixRain !== 'undefined' so app.js never breaks if rain.js failed to load).

Behavioral specification: Register phosphor theme in the theme system. Ensure rain animation starts/stops correctly with theme changes.

Acceptance condition: 'phosphor' is in THEMES array with correct icon. applyTheme() calls MatrixRain.start/stop appropriately. Guard prevents errors if rain.js is missing.
